radius_authenticate
       radius_authenticate command creates a RADIUS access request message, sends to the given RADIUS server and returns the
       request result.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       radius_authenticate command creates a RADIUS access request message, sends to the given RADIUS server and returns the
       request result.

RETURN VALUE
       Return 1 if the user access request is accepted; 0 rejected.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0.0 --First introduced the command.
